sloka: दश पञ्च चतुर्वर्गान् सप्तवर्गं च तत्त्वत: ।अष्टवर्गं त्रिवर्गं च विद्यास्तिस्रश्च राघव ॥ २.१००.६९॥
transliteration: daśa pañca caturvargān saptavargaṁ ca tattvata: ।aṣṭavargaṁ trivargaṁ ca vidyāstisraśca rāghava ॥ 2.100.69॥

translations.english: O highly sagacious Bharata, I trust, having understood their true nature you are appropriately following the ten, five and four divisions, the seven divisions, the eight divisions, the three divisions, three kinds of knowledge, victory over the senses, the six qualities, evils arising from destiny and human agency, kritya, division of twenty, similarly Prakriti and Mandalas and two sources of Yatra and chastisement and of peace and war.
